entry.summary: Preview conversation file links in the web UI (images / text / Markdown / highlighted code / git diff) — click a link to open a preview modal instead of the desktop opener; loopback-fenced routes with weak ETag/304 caching and DOMPurify sanitization. Exact install spec: @wingsky-1/dsh-web-file-preview. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
